parsed.reason: The reason correctly identifies the item as a birthday party for another child, which is exactly the rule for a kid verdict, and it is a single plain clause. It overreaches slightly by asserting that the family's kids (plural) would attend. The item names no guest. At 18 months Wren is an unlikely invitee to a 4th birthday, so the reason states attendance as fact when the item does not support it. Calling it a party for another child would have been enough.
